en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad square lined with several‑story historic buildings and shops, with awnings over the storefronts and early 20th‑century cars and buses parked in the open space. The perspective looks along a street leading away from the square, with a decorative towered building on the right side. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge in Dutch, identifying the location as the Groote Markt with Burchtstraat in Nijmegen.
